discover_intro.label: Music Assistant will search your network for LIFX lights. Make sure they are powered (they may be switched off in the app) and on the same network as Music Assistant.

broadcast_address.label: Broadcast address
broadcast_address.description: Address the discovery broadcast is sent to. Keep 255.255.255.255 unless your lights are not found, then try your subnet's broadcast address (e.g. 192.168.1.255).

extra_hosts.label: Additional light IP addresses
extra_hosts.description: Optional comma separated IP addresses of LIFX lights to probe directly, for networks that block broadcasts.

lights.label: Lights
lights.description: The LIFX lights that should react to music.

grouping.label: Light players
grouping.description: How the selected lights are turned into Music Assistant light players.

options.group: One player per LIFX group (rooms from the LIFX app)
options.all: One player with all selected lights

color_mode.label: Mode
color_mode.description: Visualization style. Smooth (default): spectrum-driven brightness with a slowly drifting palette. Ambient: colour cycling only, no brightness modulation. Flashing: brightness pulse on every beat, stronger on downbeats. Energetic: large brightness swings on hits plus fast palette rotation.

light_latency_ms.label: Light latency (ms)
light_latency_ms.description: Milliseconds to render light updates ahead of the audio, to offset the Wi-Fi and bulb delay. Increase if the lights lag the music, decrease if they run ahead of it.

transition_ms.label: Transition (ms)
transition_ms.description: Fade time the bulbs use to move to each new colour. Higher is smoother, lower is snappier.

power_on.label: Switch on lights that are off
power_on.description: Turn on lights that are off while music plays. Every light returns to its previous state (colour and power) when the music stops.

user.title: Find your LIFX lights
user.description: Music Assistant will search your network for LIFX lights.

discovering.title: Searching for LIFX lights
discovering.progress_text: Searching the network for LIFX lights...

select_lights.title: Select your lights
select_lights.description: {0} LIFX light(s) found. Pick the lights that should react to music and how to group them.

manifest.description: Sync LIFX lights to music over the LAN protocol.

errors.no_lights_found: No LIFX lights were found. Check that they are powered and on the same network, or enter their IP addresses.
